identity.name: China Express
notes: The chain-style ledger ID resolves to the single China Express storefront behind the American Builder Business Center in Tysons; the official site and both linked vendors agree on 8455-M Tyco Road and phone 703-918-9800.

sources.excerpt: Official homepage identifies the Tysons Corner restaurant at 8455-M Tyco Road, Vienna, VA 22182 and links its menu, Mealage ordering, catering page, and ezCater.

Current two-page 2026 menu covers lunch specials, appetizers, soups, poultry, pork, beef, seafood, vegetarian dishes, noodles/rice, chef specialties, desserts, and bottle soda; descriptions provide narrow literal ingredient positives. Footer says gluten free is available upon request.
Official catering page confirms the same Tysons identity and links the current ezCater storefront.
Restaurant-linked Mealage ordering URL resolved but did not expose a crawlable complete item list.
DoorDash Commerce storefront confirms 8455-M Tyco Road and current dinner categories matching the official PDF, including food, dessert, soft drink, and party-tray sections.
Restaurant-linked ezCater catalog at 8455-M Tyco Road provides a complete current catering menu with literal descriptions and one consolidated boxed-lunch product.
Official-document inspection found the superseded 2025 menu and current 2026 PDF but no allergen matrix, nutrition guide, ingredient guide, FAQ, or separate downloadable allergy document.

Targeted searches using restaurant name/address/domain plus allergen, allergy, nutrition, ingredients, gluten, PDF, and menu terms surfaced the official menus and vendors but no formal allergen matrix.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: The official 2026 menu says less oil, less salt, and gluten free are available upon request.
restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.notes: This is not applied as proof that any menu item is gluten-free or free from cross-contact.

items.notes: Baseline row is a homepage category phrase combining current Fried Rice with a brown-rice substitution; the current product is separately represented as fried-rice.
The homepage retains an old marketing mention, but the complete current 2026 PDF and current ordering/catering catalogs do not offer a vegetarian General Tso's Chicken.

findings.summary: Despite the chain-style ledger ID, all first-party and linked-vendor evidence resolves to the 8455-M Tyco Road Tysons storefront; unrelated China Express locations were excluded.
The four-row baseline contains homepage category labels rather than the current menu. The consolidated current boundary contains 130 products across the official 2026 PDF and linked catering catalog.

No formal official allergen matrix was found after all four required searches; direct positives are limited to literal current menu/vendor ingredient text and every other product is marked unavailable.
The broad menu statement that gluten-free preparation is available upon request is retained only at restaurant level and is not used as an item-level absence or cross-contact guarantee.

proposedChanges: Replace the four homepage-category rows with the 130-product consolidated union of the official 2026 menu and restaurant-linked ezCater catalog.
Collapse lunch, party-tray, catering-size, protein-choice, and beverage-choice presentations into stable products while retaining surface references.
Remove the stale Vegetarian General Tso's Chicken marketing mention and the combined Fried Rice and Brown Rice category artifact.
Preserve only literal direct ingredient positives and keep the broad gluten-free-upon-request language at restaurant level without unsupported item-level negatives.
